authorship: Original native Swift format for this fork; not Adobe PSD/PSB and not an Adobe standard
legacy: Readers retain existing PhotoCraftSwift binary-plist versions1–10. NativeArchive.encode remains the version10 compatibility encoder. NativeArchive.encodeChunked/write and desktop standard saves emit11.
body: Zero or more contiguous unique blobs, then a binary-plist manifest. No gaps/overlaps/unindexed trailing data. Blob insertion order follows document encoding; tile indices are sorted.

manifest.document: Existing Codable CraftDocument; surface packingVersion3 binds tileData string digests to owned blobs; selection coverage uses historyBytes digest. No filesystem paths are followed.
manifest.blobs: Ordered array of digest (lowercase SHA256 hex), offset (UInt64), length (UInt64); every entry must be referenced by the decoded document; maximum65536 records.
manifest.tiles: Existing TileArchive representation: byte0 raw=0 or zlib=1, followed by exactly4096 portable little-endian Float32 RGBA samples after expansion. Exact finite sample bits; no color conversion.
manifest.selection: Raw canvas-space GRAY8 coverage; dimensions and byte count validate before document publication.

integrity: Validate header/footer, manifest hash/version/table ranges, every referenced blob hash, raster budget and complete document before publication; reject unused entries. SHA256 is corruption detection, not authentication.

limits.metadata: Manifest remains memory resident; current document and selection arrays are materialized. This is not active-tile paging or multi-GB qualification.

API.uploads: Both archive representations accepted with existing resource limits and errors
API.Adobe_interface: No native archive route or proprietary Adobe action invented; published PSD output contracts unchanged

persistence: AtomicFileWriter under existing AppKit coordinated saves; explicit discard on failed writes; recovery file leaf reads/writes supported but crash/relaunch recovery not yet qualified
backwards_compatibility_notice: Older Photato readers do not read version11. Existing native files convert only when explicitly saved by the new app. Existing API defaults remain10.
